mission: Assist U.S. communities and authorized system owners with public-source cyber readiness planning, defensive prioritization, evidence hygiene and official reporting pathways.

profiles.label: State, local, tribal or territorial team

functions.label: GOVERN
functions.objective: Define accountable ownership, policies, oversight and legal/privacy obligations.
actions: Assign a named security decision-maker and document who can authorize changes.
Document reporting obligations, privacy requirements, critical suppliers and escalation contacts.

functions.label: IDENTIFY
functions.objective: Understand owned assets, dependencies and potential consequences of service disruption.
actions: Inventory only assets you own or are explicitly authorized to assess; classify essential services and data.
Map critical suppliers and prioritize exposed products against official CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities notices.

functions.label: PROTECT
actions: Use phishing-resistant multifactor authentication, least privilege and timely patching on authorized systems.
Maintain protected, routinely tested backups and segment high-consequence networks where approved.

functions.label: DETECT
functions.objective: Recognize unusual activity in authorized telemetry.
actions: Review alerts and logs only from systems where monitoring is authorized.
Correlate official security advisories with the owned asset inventory; verify each alert before escalation.

functions.label: RESPOND
functions.objective: Coordinate and communicate verified cybersecurity incidents.
actions: Follow the organization-approved incident response plan; preserve evidence and contain only under established authority.
Escalate through the owner/operator and relevant incident reporting channel; do not upload sensitive incident details to this public website.

functions.label: RECOVER
functions.objective: Restore service safely and learn from incidents.
actions: Restore from tested backups under the organization-approved continuity and recovery plan.
Validate service integrity and document corrective actions, restoration status and lessons learned.

boundaries.public_publication: Public source references and voluntary generic readiness plans only; no claim to protect or monitor all USA networks.
boundaries.active_testing: Active scanning, endpoint changes, account access or incident response require documented ownership/authorization and separate approved tools; this page implements none.
boundaries.data: No classified data, credentials, access tokens, private system inventories, victim data, financial records, or incident case files collected by this scope panel.
boundaries.automation: No continuous checks, live agent deployment, threat blocking, incident submission, or monitoring initiated by this page.
boundaries.evidence: Plans are advisory; they do not establish compliance, a completed security audit, or operational readiness.
boundaries.authority: Not a government agency, contractor, incident responder, or authorized nationwide infrastructure operator.
